item.description:
Inside Up Games is a Canadian design and publishing company founded by Conor McGoey in 2016. Our mission is simple, we create exciting and entertaining games that you can enjoy with family and friends!

Stay up to date on the latest Inside Up Games news, including Kickstarter launches and late pledge announcements. ➡️https://direct.me/insideupgames

Where to Find Us
Join the party! Here’s where you can find Inside Up Games across the web.

Twitter: Follow Inside Up Games on Twitter
Facebook: Follow Inside Up Games on Facebook
Instagram: Follow Inside Up Games on Instagram
Discord: Join the conversation on the Inside Up Games Discord server
Newsletter: Stay in the loop by subscribing to Inside Up Game’s newsletter
Website: Check out the Inside Up Games website to learn more about our games

Need Help?
If you have missing or damaged parts, please fill out this form. If you need to reach a member of the team, send a message our way.

Want to Work With Us?
Great, we’re excited to get in touch!

If you’re a reviewer who’d like to check out our games, please fill out this form.
Already love Inside Up Games? Learn more about our ambassador program.


Are you a retailer who’d like to carry our games? Reach out to us.

Our Games
Whether you enjoy cooperative gameplay, trick-taking, engine building, or tile placement we have a game to suit your tastes. Have fun at the table!
Our current catalog of games includes titles such as Summit: The Board Game and its three expansions: Teams, Yeti, and Sanity, Earth and its expansions: Abundance, and Animal Kingdom, the Twisted Realms series: Crits & Tricks, Thieves of Eldris, and Tug of Roar, Terminus, Gorus Maximus and its reimplementation Sea Change, 7 Souls, The Quick and the Undead, Draft and Write Records, Perch, City Builder: Ancient World, Block and Key and Ice and Idols.

Adventure Store, Behind the Lens, Earth Express and more are coming in 2027!
